visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins with a street view featuring white residential buildings with black balconies. Overlaid are three large, 3D blue arrows pointing right. Text with a white outline and colorful shadows reads 'Google 實景 竟然有 這個 功能!!' at the bottom. The lighting is bright natural daylight under a blue sky with white clouds. (2) A man with short black hair is sitting in the driver's seat of a car. He wears a white T-shirt and a black crossbody bag. He looks directly at the camera, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. A floating UI icon with a question mark appears near his head. (3) The visual shifts to a mobile screen recording of an application interface. It shows various icons like FaceTime, Calendar, and a speedometer app named 'GodShield' (神盾). A blue and red circular gauge is visible at the bottom. A small floating window of the speedometer app appears over the home screen. (4) A screen recording of Google Maps shows a navigation route. A small, rectangular floating window containing a speedometer and '200 公尺' text is pinned to the top right of the map interface. Blue navigation lines are visible on the map. (5) The man is now standing outdoors on a sidewalk next to a street. He holds a smartphone in his left hand and points toward the camera with his right hand. He wears the same white shirt and black bag. The background shows parked cars and residential buildings under bright sunlight. (6) The view switches to a first-person perspective through a smartphone camera. Large blue 3D arrows are superimposed onto the real-world street view, guiding the way. A warning box appears on screen saying '注意安全' with a yellow exclamation mark icon. (7) The man is back on screen, standing outside. He laughs and gestures toward the street while looking slightly away from the camera. The street has parked cars and green trees in the background. (8) Final shot shows the man smiling and looking at the camera, holding his phone, with '推薦給大家' text overlaying the screen.

(6) [Subtitle]: 地圖 神盾 (可移動式畫面). (7) [Subtitle]: 你不用在地圖跟那個 神盾切換來切換去. (8) [Subtitle]: 我還有看過有人 用兩隻手機的. (9) [Slogan]: 各位Google地圖 有一個超厲害的功能. (10) [Subtitle]: 就是你去 國外啊 或則是妳 找不到地點. The BGM maintains a consistent high tempo around 128 BPM. (5) As the speaker interacts with the AR arrows, 'wow' vocal expressions and stylized 'whoosh' SFX accentuate the motion. narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction of Speed App -> Navigation Integration -> Google AR Feature -> Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a practical tech tutorial aimed at mobile users, specifically drivers and pedestrians. It demonstrates how to use the 'GodShield' speed alert app in background mode alongside Google Maps, and highlights the 'Live View' AR walking navigation feature in Google Maps to make navigating unfamiliar streets easier and more engaging.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator specifically names and demonstrates the features of the 'GodShield' (神盾) app and Google Maps, recommending them to the audience.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes high-density editing with frequent UI sound effects and text overlays to maintain a fast, social-media-friendly pace. The use of AR navigation visuals adds a 'gamified' feel to the instructional content.
